sections.description:
HIGH COURT JUDGES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCE)
HIGH COURT JUDGES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCE)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1988
PRESIDENT'S ORDER I OF 1988
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
18th February, 1988]
No.F.17(1)/88-Pub., dated 18-2-1988.--The following Order made by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the High Court Judges
(Traveling Allowance) Order, 1965 (P.O.No.4 of 1965), for the purposes
hereafter appearing;
And whereas paragraph 2 of the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution relating
to the High Court provides that every Judge of a High Court shall be entitled
to such privileges and allowances, and to such rights in respect of leave of
absence and pension, as may be determined by the President;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by the aforesaid
paragraph, the President is pleased to make the following Order, namely: --
1. Short title and commencement.----(1) This Order may be called the High Court Judges (Traveling Allowance)
(Amendment) Order, 1988.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of July, 1987.
2. Amendment of Paragraph 7, P.O. No.4 of 1965.----In the High Court Judges (Traveling Allowance)
Order, 1965 (P.O. No.4 of 1965), hereinafter referred to as the said Order, in
paragraph 7, for the words "one rupee" the words "two
rupees" shall be substituted.
3. Amendment opt Paragraph 10, P.O. No.4 of 1965.----In the said Order, in paragraph 10,-
(a) after the words and comma "to another," the words and
comma "or appointed to an office other than that of Judge at a place other
than the principal seat of the High Court," shall be inserted; and
(b) in clause (3), for the figure "2,000" the figure
"4,000", and for the figure "1,000" the figure
"2,000", shall be substituted.
4. Amendment of Paragraph 11, P.O. No.4 of 1965.--In the said Order, in paragraph 11, in
sub-paragraph (1),--
(a) for the words "one hundred and ten" the words "one
hundred and forty" shall be substituted; and
(b) in the proviso, for the words "one hundred and thirty" the
words "one hundred and sixty-five", and for the word
"Lyallpur" the word "Faisalabad", shall be substituted.
